_note: Deterministic routing lint input for test_skill_triggers.py. It checks that each skill description still carries the signal terms real requests use; it does not run a model. Real model trigger runs remain a manual check. A skill may carry a "holdout" object (same two lists) of prompts kept out of description tuning: tune on the top-level lists, judge an edit with `trigger_eval_run.py --set holdout`. A holdout prompt that has been seen or used to judge an edit moves to the top-level lists and new holdout prompts are written. "known_misses" lists should-trigger prompts measured as not triggering; the routing lint and the runner skip them, so the gap stays visible without making the lint pass or fail on it.
